## Scientific change

Describe the method, value, or result being changed and why. Link any related issue.

## Research evidence

Link the research paper and provide its DOI if available, or an arXiv identifier or stable paper reference. Identify the relevant equation, table, or dataset. Include units and explain how the source supports this change.

## Validation

Give the inputs and units, the expected and observed results, and the checks you ran. Explain any differences or checks you could not run.
